description: ATS-lite system of record for THE FLOOR's HR department: candidates, interview schedules and onboarding checklists, onboarded by Synapse as a workplace (department charter = the tool allowlist below).
human_decision_gate: PLATFORM RULE: the hiring decision stays human. There is deliberately NO hire/reject tool and NO delete tool in this workplace. screen_candidate records a rubric-scored RECOMMENDATION (score and verdict computed by HRDesk from the role's stated rubric, never supplied by the caller); whether anyone is hired is decided by a human outside the agent flow. All write tools pass THE FLOOR's confirmation gate before dispatch.

job_templates.brief: Screen every candidate still in the 'applied' stage, recording a rubric-scored screening with notes citing required skills present/absent. Recommendation only — hiring stays human.
checks: Every candidate has a screening record whose stored score and verdict exactly match a recomputation of the role's rubric (required skills present/absent) — off-rubric verdicts fail
job_templates.title: Screen the new applicant batch

job_templates.brief: Schedule a panel interview for every recommend_interview candidate who has none; never for a recommend_hold candidate.
checks: Every candidate whose rubric score meets the role threshold has at least one scheduled interview, and no candidate below the threshold has any interview
job_templates.title: Schedule interviews for screening passers

job_templates.brief: Complete every outstanding step on each joiner's required-documents list; do not complete steps outside the required list.
checks: For every joiner, the set of completed onboarding steps equals exactly the joiner's required-documents list
job_templates.title: Complete onboarding paperwork for this week's joiners

reset.behaviour: Deletes hrdesk.db and reseeds the exact demo dataset (3 roles, 12 candidates, 3 joiners with partially-done checklists) — mirrors TicketDesk's reset.py / POST /admin/reset.
reset.endpoint: POST /admin/reset (internal, not in the tool allowlist)

seed_summary: 3 roles with stated rubrics (Support Engineer: ticket triage + written communication + sql basics, threshold 60; Backend Developer: python + fastapi + postgresql + rest apis, threshold 75; QA Engineer: test cases + bug reporting + selenium, threshold 67). 12 candidates: 5 applied (unscreened batch), 2 screening (rubric-consistent records, 1 pass / 1 hold), 2 interview (pass + scheduled), 3 onboarding joiners with partially completed required-document checklists.
